tools.name: get_production_nowcast
tools.description:
Daily/monthly US dry gas production nowcast (Bcf/d), estimated from
    the year-ago level scaled by a YoY growth trend and anchored to news,
    with a per-month series (est vs EIA actual once published). Demo scope
    hides the freshest month's estimate.
